items.title: Noetherian Stein factorization for spaces: finite middle map, fibres killed by the theorem on formal functions

items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y proper of algebraic spaces over S with Y locally Noetherian, the factorization X -> Y' -> Y has f' proper with geometrically connected fibres, pi FINITE (sharper than the general theorem's integral), f'_*O_X = O_{Y'}, Y' = Spec_Y(f_*O_X) the normalization. The retained proof is complete: the universally-closed factorization (L16209) plus coherence of f_*O_X over a Noetherian base upgrades pi to finite; connectedness is the written formal-functions argument — after replacing Y by Y', the theorem on formal functions for spaces identifies the completed local ring O^_hat{Y,ybar} with lim H^0(X_n) over the infinitesimal fibre thickenings; a disjoint open-and-closed splitting of the geometric fibre lifts to idempotents e_{1,n} compatible along the tower (finite-order thickening, same topological space), producing a nontrivial idempotent in a local ring — contradiction. Retained author proof at lines 8148-8194.
